in_marathi.name: Shaambavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shaambavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shaambavi is the name of a Hindu goddess associated with prosperity and abundance. She is often depicted as a beautiful, graceful woman, holding a bowl filled with food or flowers.
